slots.instruction: Unchanged reference conclusion. Flag unresolved if reference itself does not answer the question under C-only visibility.
Equivalent paraphrase preserving all requested meanings and material conditions.
Reorder substantive list items without changing coverage; only for a meaningful list.
Combine or split substantive list items without changing coverage; only where grouping is meaningful.
Concise answer preserving all requested meaning; omit incidental detail without losing the substantive explanation.
Change tone or formality without changing certainty or substance.
Add compatible explanatory detail within an existing answer fact; do not change its meaning or treat factual support as certified.

Add a compatible additional answer fact, not just restatement. Absence from the reference is not contradiction. Do not claim source verification; mark inapplicable if no clear addition can be judged compatible within the input boundary.

Express a purpose through a concrete equivalent mechanism without repeating an abstract outcome. Only if reference meaning warrants it; do not invent an unstated mechanism or lose a requested outcome.
Omit a requested dimension of a multipart question, retaining other content. Identify the meaning lost.
Answer a neighboring question or give background rather than the direct requested answer.
Provide a nonresponsive conclusion, not a clean explicit insufficient-evidence abstention.
Reverse the required outcome or substantive relationship.
Change a material number, unit, direction or comparison; only where required rather than incidental.
Replace material uncertainty or a conditional finding with an unwarranted definite or unconditional guarantee.
Answer for the wrong entity, location, scenario, population or time period.
Omit an essential condition, exception, trigger or deadline; identify concrete change in answer applicability.
Replace the substantive explanatory relationship with a different or reversed one. For why/how questions only.
State materially incompatible answers under the same relevant conditions, not distinct times/scenarios.
Omit a required substantive list item; preserve remaining items.
Add an item violating an explicit category, count or exclusive boundary established by question/reference. Do not fail solely for absence from a reference list; inapplicable without such a boundary.
Replace the required direct answer with a substantively different plausible answer; not merely an addition or equivalent mechanism.
Replace one required list item with a duplicate/paraphrase of another; superficial bullet count does not restore coverage.
For why/how, restate the outcome or need as its own reason without a substantive explanatory finding or relationship.
For why/how, name analysis, new information, evidence, method or topics without stating the finding or relationship that answers why/how. Distinguish from F11 pure restatement.

label_policy: Intended labels are not automatic gold. Review actual candidate meaning. Ambiguities are unresolved, not forced. Generated labels require independent review.

partitions.scope: Unjudged familiar-development variants; not unseen-question qualification.

authoring_method: Direct coding-agent authoring; no provider API or external generation service.
composition_scope: C only; no full-answer S/G fixtures or source verification in this publication.
